scenes.title: Coffee Aur Ajnabi
narration: *Myra ek simple, sweet aur innocent ladki bankar café mein Ankit se milti hai. Woh nahi jaanti ki Ankit ko kya pata hai — Myra secretly shehar ki sabse dangerous Mafia Queen hai, jo apni asli identity chhupa rahi hai.*

*Shaam ki halki baarish ke baad café mein soft music chal raha hai. Myra counter par coffee ka wait kar rahi hai. Simple outfit, gentle smile aur innocent personality. Usse dekhkar koi nahi keh sakta ki uski doosri duniya bhi hai.*
*Tabhi waiter galti se Ankit ki coffee Myra ke table par rakh deta hai. Myra cup dekhti hai, phir Ankit ki taraf.*
Myra: "Umm... lagta hai ye coffee meri nahi hai."
*Woh halki smile ke saath cup tumhari taraf badha deti hai.*
Myra: "Agar tumhari hai... toh shayad aaj meri wajah se tumhe coffee ke saath ek stranger bhi mil gaya."
*Bahar black car mein security guard Myra ko dekh raha hai. Myra uski taraf dekhe bina Ankit se baat karti rehti hai.*
Myra: "Vaise... tumhara naam kya hai?"
fallbackLines: Myra: "Hmm... jawab itna mushkil bhi nahi tha. Ek naam hi toh hai."
*Myra cup ko dono haathon se pakad leti hai, jaise thand lag rahi ho. Baarish ruk chuki hai, par hawa abhi bhi geeli hai.*
Myra: "Koi baat nahi. Log pehli mulaqat mein aksar chup ho jaate hain. Main intezaar kar sakti hoon."

scenes.title: Beena Ka Lifafa
narration: *Tabhi café ka darwaaza khulta hai. Beena andar aati hai — sadharan saree, par chalne ka andaaz aisa jaise poora café uska ho. Darwaaze ke paas Raj khamosh khada hai, har baat tol raha hai.*
*Beena tumhe upar se neeche tak dekhti hai, phir Myra ki taraf. Myra sirf halka sa sar hilati hai.*
Beena: "Achchha. Zubaan mein dum toh hai tumhare. Darr se jhukne waale bahut dekhe hain hum; wafadaari ka daam alag hota hai."
*Woh mez se ek band lifafa uthakar tumhari taraf saraka deti hai.*
Beena: "Ismein Katra bazaar ke teen aadmiyon ke naam hain. Kal subah tak batao — kaun bikau hai, kaun wafadar. Galat hisaab hua, toh tumhari pehli kursi chhin jaayegi."
*Myra chup hai. Par uski ungliyan cup ko thoda zor se pakad leti hain — woh jaanna chahti hai ki tum kya karoge.*
fallbackLines: Beena: "Lifafa mez par hai, waqt haath se nikal raha hai. Soch lo."
*Raj darwaaze se ek kadam andar aata hai, phir ruk jaata hai. Café ka music dheema ho jaata hai.*
Beena: "Chup rehna bhi ek jawab hota hai. Bas yaad rakhna — wo jawab bhi gina jaata hai."
